WESTLAKE VILLAGE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Energy Vault Holdings, Inc. (“Energy Vault”) (NYSE: NRGV), a global energy storage company today announced that, effective on November 4, 2026, the Compensation Committee of Energy Vault’s Board of Directors granted to 22 new employees restricted stock unit awards covering an aggregate 1,230,250 shares of its common stock under the Energy Vault Holdings, Inc. 2022 Employment Inducement Award Plan (as amended and/or restated, the “Plan”). The awards were granted as awards material to new employees entering into employment with Energy Vault in accordance with New York Stock Exchange Listing Rule 303A.08.

The restricted stock units vest over four years and are subject to the employee’s continued service. The awards are subject to the terms and conditions of the Plan and an award agreement thereunder.

About Energy Vault

Energy Vault® is an integrated power infrastructure platform that builds, owns and operates flexible, reliable energy systems to accelerate time-to-power for utilities, independent power producers, industrial customers and the AI and data center market. At the core of its platform is a technology-agnostic, software-enabled architecture that is designed to accelerate project delivery, optimize performance and drive faster time-to-revenue. Energy Vault’s integrated solutions combine energy storage, generation and advanced energy management to deliver scalable infrastructure tailored to customer needs. Its portfolio spans short-, long- and multi-day duration storage, designed to enable reliability, flexibility and cost efficiency across applications. For utilities and grid operators, Energy Vault provides firm, flexible capacity that ​enhances grid stability and helps to ensure reliable power delivery. For industrial and data center customers, the platform enables resilient, cost-efficient power supply to support critical operations. Through its Build, Own & Operate model, Energy Vault generates long-term, recurring revenues while delivering project execution excellence across development, delivery and operations. By combining innovation with disciplined execution, Energy Vault is redefining how power infrastructure is developed and deployed – delivering reliability, flexibility and scale in a rapidly evolving global energy market. Please visit www.energyvault.com for additional information.

BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- CRA International, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRAI), a worldwide leader in providing economic, financial, and management consulting services, today announced that an auction process will be conducted for FirstEnergy Pennsylvania Electric Company (FE PA), a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp., to procure full requirements Default Supply generation service for its Default Service Customers. The auction process will lead up to the auction scheduled for January 19, 2027.

The bidding process will use a descending-price clock auction format. The auction will be managed by Independent Evaluator and Auction Manager, CRA International, Inc. The auction is being conducted pursuant to FE PA’s Default Service Program (DSP-VII) as approved by the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission on October 22, 2026. This is the first auction in the DSP-VII auction series.

The information session for prospective bidders for the January auction is scheduled for Monday, November 23, 2026. Instructions on how to join the webcast are available on the Information Website at http://www.fepaauction.com/Documents/BidderInformationSessions.aspx.

Part 1 Applications from prospective bidders will be accepted starting November 24, 2026, and are due no later than December 11, 2026. For successful Part 1 applicants, the submission window for the Part 2 Application process will be December 17, 2026 through January 5, 2027.

The products that FE PA is procuring in the January DSP-VII Residential and Commercial (Fixed-Price) auction include a 12-month residential class product (delivery period June 2027 through May 2028), a 24-month residential class product (delivery period June 2027 through May 2029), a 60-month residential class product (delivery period June 2027 through May 2032), a 12-month commercial class product (delivery period June 2027 through May 2028), and a 24-month commercial class product (delivery period June 2027 through May 2029).

Key Terms

descending-price clock auctiontechnical
A descending-price clock auction is a multi-round auction where the seller announces a starting price and then repeatedly lowers that price (the “clock”) while bidders publicly state how many units they would buy at each price. The process stops when total stated demand is less than or equal to the quantity offered; the auction clears at the final price and the available units are allocated, typically pro rata among bidders if demand still exceeds supply at the stopping price. Because bidders see aggregate demand as the price moves, the format reveals price sensitivity over time and prevents winners from paying more than the clearing level.

VERLINVEST S.A. RECOMMENDS THAT HOLDERS OF SECURITIES OF OATLY GROUP AB SHOULD NOT TENDER INTO THE TENDER OFFER DESCRIBED IN THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. THE OFFER CONSIDERATION IS SUBSTANTIALLY BELOW THE MARKET PRICE OF OATLY GROUP AB'S SECURITIES AND VERLINVEST S.A. DOES NOT BELIEVE IT IS FAIR TO THE HOLDERS OF SUCH SECURITIES. THE OFFER IS TECHNICAL IN NATURE, AND IS BEING MADE SOLELY TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF SWEDISH LAW IN CONNECTION WITH VERLINVEST S.A.'S PROPOSED BUYOUT OF ITS JOINT VENTURE PARTNER.

BRUSSELS, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Verlinvest S.A. ("Verlinvest"), an international, family-backed evergreen investment company, today announced that it has commenced a tender offer to purchase all of the outstanding ordinary shares, quota value SEK 0.0015 per share (the "Shares"), and all of the outstanding American Depositary Shares, each representing twenty Shares (the "ADSs" and, together with the Shares, the "Offer Securities") of Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY), a public limited liability company organized under the laws of Sweden ("Oatly" or the "Company") in exchange for $0.2065 per Share (that is not represented by an ADS) or $4.13 per ADS, as applicable, in cash, without interest and subject to any applicable withholding taxes upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Offer to Purchase for Cash dated November 20, 2026 (the "Offer to Purchase") and in the related Letter of Transmittal for ADSs (the "ADS Letter of Transmittal") and Acceptance Form for Shares (the "Acceptance Form for Shares" which, together with the Offer to Purchase, the ADS Letter of Transmittal and other related materials, as each may be amended or supplemented from time to time, collectively constitute the "Offer").

The ADSs are listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market ("Nasdaq") under the symbol "OTLY", and the Shares are not listed on any exchange (but if at least 20 Shares are held, multiples of 20 shares may be deposited with the depositary bank for the ADSs and exchanged for ADSs that are listed on Nasdaq). On November 19, 2026, the business day prior to the launch of the Offer, the closing price of the ADSs as reported on Nasdaq was $7.17 per ADS, equivalent to $0.3585 per underlying Share. The offer consideration of $0.2065 per Share or $4.13 per ADS, as applicable, represents a discount of approximately 42.4% to the November 19, 2026 closing price, a discount of 59.4% to the volume-weighted average closing price of the ADSs as quoted on Nasdaq over the three months prior to the date on which the Offer was launched, which was $10.18 and a discount of 61.5% to the volume-weighted average closing price of the ADSs as quoted on Nasdaq over the six months prior to the date on which the Offer was launched, which was $10.74.

ACCORDINGLY, THE OFFER CONSIDERATION IS SUBSTANTIALLY BELOW THE MARKET PRICE OF THE ADSs, AND VERLINVEST RECOMMENDS THAT HOLDERS OF ADSs AND SHARES NOT ACCEPT THE OFFER AND NOT TENDER THEIR SHARES OR ADSs IN THE OFFER.

VERLINVEST DOES NOT BELIEVE THAT THE OFFER IS FAIR, FROM A FINANCIAL POINT OF VIEW, TO THE SECURITY HOLDERS OF OATLY. VERLINVEST RECOMMENDS THAT SECURITY HOLDERS OF OATLY NOT ACCEPT THE OFFER AND NOT TENDER THEIR SHARES OR ADSs IN THE OFFER.

The Offer is being made solely to comply with the requirements of the Swedish Stock Market (Takeover Bids) Act (2006:451) (the "Swedish Statute") in connection with Verlinvest's proposed acquisition of the indirect interest held by its joint venture partner, Blossom Key (Hong Kong) Holdings Limited ("Blossom Key"), an indirect subsidiary of China Resources Enterprise, Limited ("China Resources"), in the Oatly securities held by Nativus Company Limited ("Nativus"), which is Oatly's largest shareholder. Each of Verlinvest and Blossom Key holds 50% of the issued shares of CR Verlinvest Health Investment Limited ("CRVV"), which holds, inter alia, all issued shares of Nativus. As of the date of the Offer to Purchase, Nativus holds 271,763,953 Shares, equal to 42.6% of the issued and outstanding Shares (excluding treasury shares) as of November 6, 2026, the latest practicable date prior to the date of the Offer to Purchase, and $209,278,211 aggregate principal amount of the Company's 9.25% Convertible Senior PIK Notes due 2028 (the "Convertible Notes"). Verlinvest wishes to acquire Blossom Key's 50% indirect interest in the Shares and the Convertible Notes held by Nativus and to directly hold all of the Shares and Convertible Notes held by Nativus.

An acquisition by Verlinvest of the Shares currently held by Nativus other than through a voluntary tender offer would trigger the mandatory tender offer requirements of the Swedish Statute, which requires any person who acquires 30% or more of the voting interests of all Shares to make a tender offer to purchase all outstanding Shares and ADSs held by all holders of Shares and ADSs in accordance with certain specific rules. Following consultation between Verlinvest and the Swedish Securities Council, the Swedish Securities Council has in two statements confirmed that Verlinvest may conduct a voluntary tender offer and acquire the Shares held by Nativus through such voluntary tender offer as an alternative to conducting a mandatory tender offer pursuant to the Swedish Statute.

Accordingly, pursuant to a Transaction Agreement, dated November 9, 2026 (the "Transaction Agreement"), by and among Verlinvest, Blossom Key, CRVV and Nativus (together, the "JV Parties"), the JV Parties have agreed, inter alia, that Verlinvest will conduct this Offer, that Nativus will tender its Shares in the Offer and that Verlinvest will, subject to the terms and conditions of the Offer, purchase such Shares in the Offer. Following the consummation of the Offer and the other transactions contemplated by the Transaction Agreement, Verlinvest will directly own all of the Shares and Convertible Notes (or other Oatly securities or assets that may be exchanged for such Convertible Notes) that are currently owned by Nativus, and none of Nativus, CRVV or Blossom Key will beneficially own any Oatly securities.

This announcement is neither an offer to purchase nor a solicitation of an offer to sell Offer Securities, and the provisions herein are subject in their entirety to the provisions of the Offer. The Offer is being made solely by the Offer to Purchase, the Acceptance Form for Shares and the related ADS Letter of Transmittal and any amendments or supplements thereto, and is being made to all holders of Offer Securities. The Offer is not being made to holders of Offer Securities in any jurisdiction in which the making of the Offer would not be in compliance with the securities, blue sky or other laws of such jurisdiction. In those jurisdictions where applicable laws or regulations require the Offer to be made by a licensed broker or dealer, the Offer will be deemed to be made on behalf of Verlinvest by one or more registered brokers or dealers licensed under the laws of such jurisdiction to be designated by Verlinvest.

The initial acceptance period for the Offer (the "Offer Period") will commence on November 20, 2026, and expire at one minute after 11:59 p.m., New York time, on December 21, 2026, unless the Offer Period is extended in accordance with the terms of the Transaction Agreement (the end of the Offer Period, as it may be extended, the "Expiration Time"). Key Terms

navfinancial
Net asset value (NAV) is the total value of all the investments and assets in a fund or company, minus any debts or liabilities, divided by the number of shares or units outstanding. It represents the per-share worth, giving investors an idea of what each share is truly worth based on the underlying assets. Think of it like a company's total worth divided among its shares, helping investors assess whether a share is fairly priced.
View in glossary
bid-ask spreadsfinancial
The bid-ask spread is the gap between the highest price someone is willing to pay for a security (the bid) and the lowest price someone will accept to sell it (the ask). Like the difference between what buyers at a garage sale will offer and what sellers want, a wider spread raises the effective cost and difficulty of trading and signals lower demand or higher uncertainty, while a narrow spread means cheaper, easier trades for investors.
swap agreementsfinancial
A swap agreement is a contract where two parties agree to exchange future cash flows or obligations—such as interest payments, currency amounts, or credit exposure—according to set terms. Investors care because swaps let companies and funds change or hedge financial risks (for example, swapping a variable-rate payment for a fixed one) without selling assets, which can alter future earnings, balance-sheet liabilities and hidden risk exposure much like trading one set of loan payments for another.
futures contractsfinancial
A futures contract is an agreement to buy or sell a specific quantity of an asset at a set price on a predetermined future date. Investors use them to lock in prices or to bet on price moves; like agreeing today on the price of a loaf of bread you'll buy months from now to avoid surprise cost changes. Because these deals often require only a small upfront payment compared with the contract size, they can both protect against risk and magnify gains or losses.

The donated protein, including bacon, ham and sausage, will provide 160,000 servings for neighbors experiencing hunger in the greater Hampton Roads area.

“Many families across the Peninsula rely on the Foodbank and its partners to access higher-cost items like proteins,” said Bob Latvis, president and CEO of the Virginia Peninsula Foodbank. “Smithfield’s commitment to helping ensure that all of our neighbors are able to prepare nutritious, complete meals during the holiday season benefits our whole community.”

More than 25 local Smithfield employees supported the 57-hour event by collecting and organizing donations at the drop-off location in Hampton, Virginia.

“Increasing access to nutritious food is one of our top priorities at the Foodbank, and protein plays an important role in supporting the health and well-being of our neighbors,” said Christopher Tan, president and CEO of the Foodbank of Southeastern Virginia and the Eastern Shore. “Protein is also one of the most expensive foods for families to purchase and for foodbanks to provide. Smithfield's generosity helps us overcome that challenge and ensures more of our neighbors have access to the quality nutrition they need to thrive.”

Smithfield’s support for the Mayflower Marathon continues its long-standing commitment to addressing food insecurity and supporting the communities where its employees live and work.

PINE BLUFF, Ark., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Simmons Bank (Simmons or Bank), a wholly owned subsidiary of Simmons First National Corporation (NASDAQ: SFNC), today issued the following statement regarding inaccurate information contained in recent articles concerning a loan to a real estate developer to finance a Texas multifamily project (Project):

Recent media reports regarding this Project contain inaccuracies. Most notably, the loan balance stated in the reports of $133 million is incorrect. The total financing provided by Simmons with respect to the Project was approximately $88 million, of which approximately $44 million was participated to another financial institution, and all of which is secured by a first lien on the property serving as collateral. Based on recent appraisals, the value of the property that serves as collateral to the loan remains well in excess of the outstanding loan balance, with an approximate loan-to-value ratio of 73 percent, and the Bank does not currently expect to incur a credit loss related to the Project.

The foreclosure filing referenced in the media reports is part of the bank's standard strategy for protecting its interests while continuing to pursue a resolution. Simmons remains engaged in constructive discussions with the Project sponsors regarding a potential workout strategy.

The Immersive Holiday Partnership Features Bespoke Frozen Yogurt by Award-winning Chef & Author Andy Baraghani, Personalized Product Experiences & Festive Programming at Bloomingdale’s 59th Street Flagship

ANDY BARAGHANI IMAGES
UGG PARLOR IMAGES
Photography credit: Julia Khoroshilov

SANTA BARBARA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--This holiday season, Southern California-based global lifestyle brand UGG® (a division of Deckers Brands [NYSE: DECK]) is partnering with Bloomingdale’s, Forty Carrots and New York Times bestselling and James Beard Award-winning chef and author, media personality and cultural tastemaker Andy Baraghani to introduce the UGG® Parlor, an unexpected fusion of fashion, food and culture at Forty Carrots. Running November 20 through January 3, the partnership brings a playful new perspective to seasonal traditions, combining Bloomingdale’s retail heritage, Forty Carrots’ cult-favorite frozen yogurt, Baraghani’s distinctive culinary perspective and the UGG® brand’s approach to self-expression.

Andy Baraghani x UGG® Parlor

“At UGG, we believe the most memorable gifts are the ones that create a feeling and bring people together in unexpected ways,” said Tracy Paoletti, Vice President & General Manager, UGG North America. “The UGG Parlor at Forty Carrots brings that philosophy to life by blending fashion, food and self-expression into a festive experience that invites consumers to make the season their own. We’re excited to partner with Bloomingdale’s, Forty Carrots and Andy Baraghani to create a new holiday tradition that celebrates the joy of giving, receiving and sharing something special.”

“I’m very much in favor of a frozen yogurt break in the middle of holiday shopping,” said Andy Baraghani. “Working with UGG and Forty Carrots was a chance to take the nostalgic flavors I love this time of year and give them a little twist. I wanted something seasonal that you’d crave well beyond the holidays. Come to the UGG Parlor, have a frozen yogurt, and stay for a second helping.”

UGG® PARLOR AT FORTY CARROTS AT BLOOMINGDALE’S

At the heart of the creative exchange is a custom frozen yogurt experience featuring two bespoke flavors created in partnership with UGG® and Andy Baraghani. UGGingerbread Spice, the signature UGG® flavor, will be available at all Forty Carrots locations across the U.S. and is the perfect balance of Bloomingdale’s signature frozen yogurt with the warm, nostalgic flavors of gingerbread, featuring notes of ginger, cinnamon, and holiday spice. UGGingerbread Nightcap by Andy Baraghani, an exclusive, bespoke creation imagined by the chef himself, will be available only at Forty Carrots at Bloomingdale’s 59th Street flagship in New York City. Featuring creamy frozen yogurt, gingerbread spice, and a hint of dark rum, it's a holiday nightcap you eat with a spoon. Both flavors will be available through January 3.

The partnership transforms an everyday treat into a festive destination, inviting shoppers to experience the partnership through seasonal flavors, personalized product and thoughtful details throughout the holiday season.

The UGG® Parlor will also come to life through a series of consumer activations, including UGG® customization experiences, frozen yogurt sampling and festive touches designed to encourage discovery and invite guests to make the experience their own.

HOLIDAY EXPERIENCES AT THE UGG® PARLOR

Across five weekends in November and December, UGG® and Forty Carrots will bring the UGG® Parlor to life through a rotating lineup of customization experiences, frozen yogurt sampling and festive treats at Bloomingdale’s 59th Street flagship.

Weekend 1: Holiday Takeover Kickoff — Froyo & Customization

Friday, November 20, 3-8 PM
Saturday, November 21-Sunday, November 22, 12-6 PM

Guests can personalize select Classic boots at the UGG® Customization Studio with laser-engraved designs from a curated holiday flash sheet featuring New York City-inspired and seasonal motifs. A custom-branded frozen yogurt sampling cart will also offer guests a taste of the partnership on the fifth floor of Bloomingdale’s 59th Street location.

Weekend 2: Personalize Your Pair

Saturday, November 28-Sunday, November 29, 12-6 PM

The UGG® Customization Studio will continue offering laser engraving on select Classic boots, inviting guests to personalize their pair with NYC-inspired and holiday designs.

Weekend 3: A Sweet Treat & Personalization

Saturday, December 5, 12-6 PM

On Saturday, December 5, customers who purchase men’s or women’s UGG® footwear in-store will be eligible to receive one complimentary small UGGingerbread Spice frozen yogurt at Forty Carrots. To redeem, customers must present their December 5 in-store purchase receipt at Forty Carrots. Offer is valid for purchases made on December 5 only and applies exclusively to the small UGGingerbread Spice frozen yogurt.

The UGG® Customization Studio will also be available for guests to personalize select Classic boots.

Weekend 4: Festive Personalization

Saturday, December 12-Sunday, December 13, 12-6 PM

Guests can continue to personalize select Classic boots with laser-engraved designs inspired by New York City and the holiday season.

Weekend 5: Holiday Sweets & Personalized Treats

Saturday, December 19-Sunday, December 20, 12-6 PM

The holiday programming will conclude with festive touches throughout Bloomingdale’s, including custom UGG® boot-shaped gingerbread cookies distributed on the Women’s sales floor, custom UGG® holiday cards with purchase and live portrait illustrations of guests wearing UGG® products.

Through January 3, The UGG® Parlor at Forty Carrots celebrates the spirit of holiday gifting through an unexpected blend of fashion, food and self-expression. By bringing together the UGG® brand’s distinctive approach to style, Forty Carrots’ iconic frozen yogurt and Andy Baraghani’s creative culinary perspective, the partnership invites shoppers to discover new seasonal traditions and Gift the Feeling through memorable moments of connection, indulgence and joy.

About UGG®

Founded in 1978 by an Australian surfer on the coast of California, UGG® is a global lifestyle brand renowned for its iconic Classic boot. First worn by Hollywood royalty, fashion editors, and then the world, UGG® designs and retails footwear, apparel, and accessories with an uncompromising attitude toward quality and craftsmanship. Delivering more than $2 billion in annual sales, UGG® partners with the best retailers globally and owns concept and outlet stores worldwide in key markets, including New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Paris, London, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Beijing. For more information, please visit ugg.com @ugg.

About Deckers Brands

Deckers Brands is a global leader in designing, marketing and distributing innovative footwear, apparel and accessories developed for both everyday casual lifestyle use and high-performance activities. The Company's portfolio of brands includes UGG®, HOKA®, and Teva®. Deckers Brands products are sold in more than 50 countries and territories through select department and specialty stores, Company-owned and operated retail stores, and select online stores, including Company-owned websites. Deckers Brands has over 50 years of history building niche footwear brands into lifestyle market leaders, attracting millions of loyal consumers globally. For more information, please visit www.deckers.com.

Bloomingdale’s is America’s only nationwide, full-line, upscale department store. A division of Macy’s, Inc. Be sure to follow @bloomingdales on social media, become a Loyallist, and for more information, or to shop any time, visit www.bloomingdales.com.

A beloved Bloomingdale’s destination since its debut in 1974, Forty Carrots is best known for its iconic frozen yogurt, alongside a menu of smoothies, salads, sandwiches and more. It has become a signature part of the shopping experience and a longtime favorite among customers.

BROOKLYN, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--VistaPrint, the print and design partner to millions of small businesses, today announced a partnership with award-winning chefs and culinary personalities, Sohla and Ham El-Waylly, to support the opening of their newest Brooklyn venture, Triangle Bar. Additional Triangle Bar partners include Anoop Pillarisetti and Michael Tuiach.

VistaPrint Partners with Acclaimed Restaurateurs Sohla and Ham El-Waylly for Opening of Brooklyn’s Triangle Bar

Located at the base of Fort Greene’s iconic triangular Fowler Square and opening in winter 2026–27, Triangle Bar is reimagining the classic neighborhood bar as a welcoming, all-occasion gathering place. The husband-and-wife duo invite guests to settle in over a pint, enjoy a comforting dinner, or linger over drinks with friends. The bar sits alongside the group’s Brooklyn restaurant, Strange Delight, a critically acclaimed, New Orleans-inspired seafood restaurant and cocktail bar in Fort Greene.

Sohla and Ham partnered with VistaPrint early in the planning process to create a consistent look and feel across every customer-facing touchpoint, including custom-printed sandwich deli paper, signature coasters, menus, takeout packaging and branded signage, t-shirts and hats.

"So much hard work goes into building a small business. Using custom print products is essential when you're trying to build an identity people remember, and we wanted every detail at Triangle Bar to feel intentional,” said Sohla and Ham El-Waylly. “When we opened Strange Delight, coordinating orders across multiple vendors while maintaining quality was exhausting. Having VistaPrint as our one-stop shop for all things branding completely streamlined the process. We're so excited to share Triangle Bar with the Fort Greene community.”

Pfizer’s $330 million upfront commitment to three pre-IND in vivo CAR-T programs highlights pharmaceutical industry interest in next-generation engineered T-cell platforms

SRX’s pending acquisition of CERo Therapeutics provides exposure to CER-1236, a clinical-stage engineered T-cell therapy with seven patients dosed in the ongoing Phase 1/1b CERTAIN-T trial

NORTH PALM BEACH, Fla., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SRX Global Inc. (NYSE American: SRXH) (the “Company” or “SRX”), an AI-enabled platform dedicated to generating long-term shareholder value through investments in high-conviction operating companies and strategic assets, today commented on recent industry activity in engineered T-cell therapies following the November 18, 2026 announcement by Pfizer Inc. (“Pfizer”) of an exclusive licensing agreement with Starna Therapeutics (“Starna”), and provided an update on its pending acquisition of CERo Therapeutics, the operating subsidiary of CERo Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. (OTCQB: CERO) (“CERo Holdings” and, together with CERo Therapeutics, “CERo”), an innovative cellular immunotherapy company advancing engineered T cell therapeutics designed to engage phagocytic mechanisms.

According to Pfizer’s announcement, the agreement covers three pre-IND in vivo chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (“CAR-T”) programs focused on treating autoimmune diseases. Starna will receive an upfront payment of $330 million and is eligible to receive up to $2.3 billion in development and commercial milestone payments, as well as royalties on net sales of approved products. Pfizer also obtained rights to Starna’s technology in inflammation and immunology and in oncology. SRX and CERo are not parties to, and have no involvement in, the Pfizer–Starna agreement.

CERo’s approach differs in technology, therapeutic focus and stage of development. Its lead investigational product candidate, CER-1236, is being evaluated in patients with hematologic malignancies in the ongoing Phase 1/1b CERTAIN-T trial. CER-1236 is based on CERo’s proprietary Chimeric Engulfment Receptor T cell (“CER-T”) platform, which is designed to integrate characteristics of innate and adaptive immunity into a single therapeutic construct intended to engage multiple immune mechanisms against cancer.

“Pfizer’s agreement with Starna is a clear signal that large pharmaceutical companies continue to commit significant capital to differentiated engineered T-cell platforms, even before those programs reach the clinic,” said Kent Cunningham, Chief Executive Officer of SRX Global. “CERo’s technology and indications are different, and we do not view this transaction as a valuation benchmark for CERo. What it does reinforce is our conviction in the long-term strategic importance of this field. CER-1236 is already being evaluated in patients, and our focus remains on supporting the CERo team as it advances the CERTAIN-T trial and on working toward closing the proposed acquisition.”

On November 3, 2026, CERo announced that it had dosed the seventh patient in CERTAIN-T, the fourth patient in the trial’s second cohort. CERo reported no dose-limiting toxicities (“DLTs”) in the three previously treated second-cohort patients during the DLT assessment period, and has reported expansion of infused CER-1236 cells following administration. In its June 2026 update, CERo reported that the observed safety profile remained consistent with earlier findings of no cytokine release syndrome, immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome, DLTs or treatment-related severe adverse events during the DLT assessment window. CERo has also expanded its clinical trial sites, including the activation of the University of California, Davis, which also serves as the primary manufacturing site for CER-1236. These clinical results are preliminary, are based on a limited number of patients, and are not sufficient to establish the safety or efficacy of CER-1236.

On October 7, 2026, SRX announced that it had entered into a definitive purchase agreement under which CERo Therapeutics will become a wholly owned subsidiary of SRX Global.

About the CERTAIN-T Trial
The first-in-human, multicenter, open-label Phase 1/1b CERTAIN-T study is designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary clinical activity of CER-1236 in patients with hematologic malignancies. The study initially enrolled patients with acute myeloid leukemia (“AML”), including relapsed/refractory AML, measurable residual disease AML, and newly diagnosed TP53-mutated AML, and the protocol has since been amended to include transfusion-dependent myelodysplastic syndromes (“TD-MDS”), high-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (“HR-MDS”), and post-JAK inhibitor myelofibrosis (“MF”). Primary endpoints include safety and tolerability. Secondary endpoints include pharmacokinetics and measures of clinical response, including overall response rate (“ORR”), complete response (“CR”), composite complete response (“cCR”), and measurable residual disease (“MRD”).

CERo refers to these engineered cells as Chimeric Engulfment Receptor T cells (“CER-T”).

X-CUE augmented-reality smart-glasses technology (product illustration).

Laonz has completed the transfer of the X-CUE business, including related intellectual property, technology, assets, and business rights, to NeuroQ.

The parties intend to leverage the technology’s extensive development history and current product readiness to advance X-CUE through the remaining clinical and regulatory processes toward potential commercialization.

$160 million reduction begins with January bills; more than $50 a year for a home using 1,000 kilowatt-hours a month

BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Alabama Power customers will pay lower rates beginning with their January bills. The company today filed with the Alabama Public Service Commission to reduce customer rates by $160 million in 2027.

A residential customer using 1,000 kilowatt-hours each month will save more than $50 a year compared with current rates at the same electricity use. However, bills and savings vary based on how much electricity a home uses. For example, a home using 2,000 kilowatt-hours a month will save about $106 a year, while a home using 750 kilowatt-hours a month will save about $40 a year.

"In January, our customers will see their rates go down because of the growth we're seeing across the state," said Jeff Peoples, Alabama Power's chief executive officer. "Alabama is growing and we're making sure that growth works for all of our customers."

Because the change lowers the rate itself, it applies to every monthly bill. Customers do not need to do anything to receive it.

The reduction is driven primarily by increased revenue expected in 2027 from large-load data centers.

"We negotiated these agreements so that growth pays for growth," said Moses Feagin, Alabama Power's chief financial officer. "Large-load data centers pay the full cost to serve their energy needs, which lowers our cost to serve other customers."

The reduction comes at a time when energy costs are rising across the country. Nationally, household electricity prices rose 4.4% over the 12 months ending in September 2026, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Electric and gas utilities requested more than $23 billion in rate increases nationwide during the first nine months of 2026, according to an October report from PowerLines.

During the same period, Alabama Power froze rates and is now lowering rates.

The lower rate results from the yearly review of Alabama Power's rates under Rate Stabilization and Equalization (RSE) set by the Alabama Public Service Commission. The rate reduction in RSE will stay at or below the new lower level through 2028.

Rates are one part of a bill. The other main factor is how much electricity a home uses. Monthly bills will continue to vary with the weather and electricity use. Through My Power Usage, Alabama Power customers can track daily electricity use and see an estimate of their upcoming bill.

More information about the rate reduction and estimated customer savings is available at AlabamaPower.com/LowerRates.

About Alabama Power

Alabama Power, a subsidiary of Atlanta-based Southern Company (NYSE: SO), provides reliable electricity to 1.6 million customers across the state. Learn more at AlabamaPower.com⁠.
